tables.label: Table 1
tables.caption: Average values and standard deviation of 9 physico-chemical characteristics for optimized clusters for 10-16 aa long peptides non-active against Human erythrocytes.
footnotes: a Attributes, which characterize space where cluster was formed. Mean and SD of these attributes are marked in bold.

tables.label: Table 2
tables.caption: Results of not hemolytic peptide prediction on the training and test sets.

tables.label: Table 3
tables.caption: Assessments of susceptibility of Escherichia coli ATCC 25922 (MIC), hemolytic activity (LC10) proteolytic stability (STP) and therapeutic index (TI) for the designed peptides.
footnotes: D—Digested; NT—not tested (if a peptide digested by a protease in a lower concentration of the protease, the experiment for the higher concentration was not carried out); PD—Partially digested; ND—not digested; LC10 (µg/mL) is a concentration required for 10% hemolysis; STP—Stability Towards Proteases at Peptide to Protease Molar ratio;* peptides, which sequences were manually changed from de novo designed sequences generated by DSP;** TI= LC10/max(MICwithout NaCl).

tables.label: Table 4
tables.caption: In vitro testing of the peptides SP1–SP4 against different gram-negative bacterial strains.
